page.text:
Power series provide the local language of holomorphic functions. Laurent
series enlarge that language by allowing negative powers, which record
the exact obstruction to holomorphic extension across an isolated point.
The coefficient of $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ is the residue and controls the
integral around the singularity.
